dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral surface exhibit sharp, high-contrast dark perimeters transitioning into diffuse, lower-intensity gray interiors. The edges are characterized by irregular, non-linear boundaries with jagged pixel transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is located on the mid-lateral flank, appearing as dense, asymmetrical patches that lack internal gradients and are distinct from the ring-like structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral, while a subset of three smaller clusters on the posterior-lateral flank forms an obtuse triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly segmented rear flipper structure with localized specular highlights on the distal margins.
